record.name: Airtable
record.one_liner: Airtable provides an MCP server supporting OAuth and Personal Access Tokens for AI agents to query and edit bases, schema, and workflows.

auth.notes: The MCP server supports OAuth (recommended for end-user connections with Dynamic Client Registration) and Personal Access Tokens (PATs for CLI, scripts, and server-side setups).

access.notes: The server is available to all users on all plans, and developers can connect via self-serve OAuth or generate Personal Access Tokens.

api_surface.notes: The pages describe a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server interface for AI agents rather than a standard REST or GraphQL API surface.

mcp.notes: Airtable exposes a remote MCP server supporting tools for bases, fields, forms, interfaces, and automations.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve access to accounts and documentation combined with standard OAuth and PAT authentication makes building integrations straightforward.

evidence.claim: Airtable provides an MCP-compatible tool layer for AI agents to read, write, and query bases.
Airtable's remote MCP server is hosted at https://mcp.airtable.com/mcp.
The MCP server supports OAuth and Personal Access Tokens (PATs) and is available to all users on all plans.
